proposals.reason: No change warranted. The paper supports univariate association of higher fasting C-peptide and insulin with remission but, in the multivariate model, C-peptide and insulin were not retained (duration, insulin use, 1-year weight change were). This does not isolate incremental value of C-peptide (the evidence gap the score rests on) and, if anything, mildly reinforces it. Score stays 2. Measure type is fasting C-peptide and insulin, not post-meal or stimulated.
proposals.quote: Diabetes remission predictors in multivariate analyses included baseline diabetes duration, insulin use, and weight change at 1 year (all P < 0.01).

path_to_viability.still_missing: A study showing C-peptide adds to duration, insulin use and BMI/weight in remission prediction. ARMMS-T2D (abstract) found C-peptide only univariately. Full text not read; the LASSO model may list it, which the abstract does not state.

no_change.reason: See proposal entry: proposed is null meaning no change, current 2 stands.
